iaa_limitation: The frozen 112-item data card retains kappa=null because that full dataset was not independently double-annotated. The separately reported kappa=0.79 validates a 40-item blind cross-model spot-check of the verification protocol (35 non-abstain pairs), not human IAA.

kappa.note: kappa is unmeasured: either no human labels were provided, or all surviving pairs fell in a single category (degenerate). Provide human labels covering at least 2 outcome categories to measure OpenAI-vs-human IAA. A fabricated kappa is NEVER written.

known_issues: Rows 97 and 98 (1-indexed) of qa_independent_v1.jsonl carry an identical question and answer string: the item was generated once as qtype=factual and once as qtype=paraphrase_alias, and the paraphrase variant retained the same surface form. The frozen set is released unchanged (n_total=112; 111 distinct question strings); per-question results in independent_eval_v1_frozen112.json cover both rows.

models.generator: mistral-small-24b (actual generator recorded on all frozen single-hop items)
models.rater: frozen 112 not fully double-annotated; the blind second rater of the verification-protocol spot-check was Claude Haiku 4.5 (cross-model, not human)
models.verifier: run-level verdict records gemini-2.5-flash; frozen row-level verifier=openai-gpt values were emitted by a legacy hard-coded writer and are not reliable provider provenance

non_circularity_guarantee: The gold labels are decided solely from raw corpus passage text and a cross-family non-extraction verifier panel. The proposed KG (its nodes, edges, and source_docs) is never imported or referenced anywhere in the gold-build pipeline (statically enforced by test_no_kg_imports), so the evaluation system cannot generate its own answers -- there is no circular code-dependency path from the KG to the gold.
release_scope: Released: questions, answers, answer-paper identifiers, evidence spans, provenance/audit records, and the frozen per-question evaluation vectors. Source passage text is EXCLUDED because per-paper redistribution rights could not be verified; exact end-to-end retrieval reruns require lawfully re-acquiring the source documents (see DATA_LICENSES.md and README, 'Path layout').

verification_protocol_spotcheck.primary_verifier: gemini-2.5-flash (Google), as recorded by the run-level verdict; raw provider responses are not available
verification_protocol_spotcheck.scope: 40-item blind cross-model spot-check of the answer-paper verification protocol; not full double annotation of frozen 112

verifier_provenance_limitation: The run-level verdict names Gemini 2.5 Flash, but every frozen row contains verifier=openai-gpt from a known hard-coded writer. Raw provider responses or receipts are not available, so the exact provider cannot be independently recovered. Frozen rows are left unchanged; see benchmark/SINGLEHOP_VERIFIER_PROVENANCE.md.
